candidates.text: Money supply keeps expanding. Bitcoin's supply doesn't. The long -term thesis is simple. These brutal corrections are opportunities to accumulate, not reasons to panic. This is interesting. Brent crude oil is dropping like a rock.

A setup like this has only happened once before in Bitcoin's entire history, and that was in 2015, and it preceded one of the most epic bull markets of all time. Seriously, send today's video to a friend post it on social media.

If you survive the post midterm shakeout, bull market incoming. And keep in mind, yes, Bitcoin falling 30 % from last month is scary, but every extreme swings back. Plus, we are still, where Bitcoin's price is today, still 10%, 11, 12%, higher than if 58K really is the bottom.

Kathy Wood, Michael Saylor, Bitwise investment research, I'll say Bitcoin to a million in the next five to ten years. Is that great? Just take the trend, the log trend channel of Bitcoin, and just extrapolate it out. And you get to about 2036, it's about a million bucks.

Bitcoin has now formed the perfect inverse head and shoulders pattern. Take a look at this. You might be bearish, but we could turn bullish quite easily. All longs have been wiped out, sentiment is bearish, and retail is going heavy short.

Remember, Morgan Stanley launched a Bitcoin ETF. Wells Fargo put Bitcoin into a model. There is massive institutional adoption. It's just happening quietly. Again, I think it's the best risk -adjusted trade in the market for the next five or ten years. I think any weakness is opportunity and I'm extraordinarily bullish.

Bitcoin is over. Crypto is done. It makes me sick seeing the markets manipulated like this. I'm going to get a lot of hate saying to you what I'm about to say to you right now, but I truly believe this.
Monthly RSI is also in the same zone as both previous lows. If this support holds again, Bitcoin could be setting up for another massive multi -year rally. Do not be fooled.
